title: What if the Sun came closer to Earth?
description:
POV: you're lying on a summer beach when Earth starts drifting toward the Sun. ☀️

Just 10% closer means almost a quarter more sunlight. At half the distance the Sun looks twice as wide, and some people run while others just stare.

Would you run or stay? 👇

New what-ifs every week on IfScape3D.
Animated with code, AI voice.
